import pixeltable as pxt

# Initialize pixeltable client
pxt.create_client()

# Get the existing docs table
table = pxt.get_table('docs')

# Add embeddings column using sentence-transformers UDF with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model
table.add_column(
    'embeddings',
    pxt.functions.embedding(table.content, model='all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
)

# Create index on embeddings for nearest-neighbor search
table.create_index('embeddings')

# Prepare query embedding
query_text = "climate change policy"
query_embedding = pxt.functions.embedding(query_text, model='all-MiniLM-L6-v2')

# Execute semantic search: select content and compute distance
results = (
    table
    .select(
        table.content,
        pxt.functions.cosine_distance(table.embeddings, query_embedding).alias('distance')
    )
    .order_by('distance')
    .limit(5)
)

# Display 5 most similar rows ranked closest to farthest
for row in results.collect():
    print(f"Distance: {row['distance']:.4f} - Content: {row['content']}")
